LightningComponentBundle.description: Drop business card images, get editable lead cards with simulated OCR extraction, then bulk-create the leads. Mock mode: no Apex, no Einstein dependency.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Scanner de cartes de visite' / 'Business Card Scanner').

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card icon
property.description: A standard:* icon name, e.g. standard:lead, standard:person_account, standard:identity.

property.name: simulatedDelayMs
property.label: Simulated OCR delay (ms)
property.description: Delay before the fake extracted data appears on each card.

property.name: maxCards
property.label: Maximum cards
property.description: Maximum number of cards in the list at once.

property.name: autoCreate
property.label: Highlight create button
property.description: When ON, the create button pulses as soon as at least one card is ready.
